text.aura: Your aura is a mountain at sunrise: solid, calm and quietly impressive. Mu carries grounded, unhurried energy that makes people relax. In a chaotic room, you're the one who looks like nothing could knock you over, and people instinctively stand near you. You read as trustworthy, mature and reliable, the friend who'll still be here in ten years. Your glow isn't flashy. It's presence. You don't need to fill silence, and that confidence is magnetic in a world of over-talkers. The glow-up for you is letting people see the warmth and humour that live inside the mountain. Think of sunlight hitting the peak: the same rock, suddenly golden and beautiful to look at.
text.how-people-read-you: First impression: calm, strong, maybe hard to read. People often assume you're very serious or unimpressed, because your expression doesn't move much. Some find you comforting, others find you intimidating. Once they know you, they discover your dry humour, your protective loyalty and how much you notice. The misreading comes from your stillness. You might seem uninterested in a conversation you're actually enjoying, or detached at an event you're secretly having fun at. A few small changes help people read you right: smile with your eyes when someone talks to you, nod more, share a quick reaction instead of waiting for the perfect one. Mountains don't need to move. They just need a path so people can climb up and enjoy the view.
text.colors: Your home palette is warm Earth: sand, camel, ochre, terracotta, chocolate, olive. These make you look rich, grounded and expensive in a quiet way, like a well-made leather bag. Fire supports Earth in the five elements, so warm reds, rust and burnt orange add life to your look. A rust sweater with camel trousers is basically your aura in an outfit. Cream and ivory freshen you up beautifully. Gold suits you more than silver. Be careful with all-grey or dull, muddy outfits with no contrast, because they can make your strong presence look heavy. Add one warm colour or a crisp cream piece to keep the mountain sunlit instead of foggy.
text.style: Your style is relaxed luxury. Quality fabrics, structured but comfortable pieces, outerwear that looks like it'll last twenty years. Think wool coats, chunky knits, tailored trousers, leather boots, a great watch. You suit an elevated basics wardrobe: few pieces, all excellent. Clean, solid silhouettes reflect your stable energy beautifully. The trap is defaulting to comfort so completely that you stop caring how you look. "Practical" can slide into "invisible." Choose one piece per outfit that feels a little special: a silk scarf, a textured jacket, a bold ring. Hair neat and natural, grooming polished and simple. Your best photo is outdoors in warm light, relaxed and grounded, with a real, slightly crooked smile that shows your humour.
text.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the warm protector. Imagine the steady K-drama character who barely speaks, then cracks one perfect joke and the whole cast falls a little in love. That's you, with the joke said a bit more often. The shift for you is playfulness. Try new things deliberately: a new café, a dance class, a different style of jacket. Let people see you being silly. Share your opinions a little sooner and with more feeling. You don't need to become chatty or loud. Your calm is your power. But a mountain with wildflowers on it is more inviting than bare rock. Let your aura carry some colour, some lightness and some open invitations for people to come closer.
text.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you get stuck. Same routine, same clothes, same evenings on the sofa, until your calm turns into heaviness. You don't look stressed exactly, you look stagnant, like a field nobody has planted in a while. People might notice you've gone quieter than usual. The reset for you is gentle movement and newness. Walk a route you've never taken. Rearrange a room. Cook a recipe from a cuisine you've never tried. Wear the warm colour you usually save for special occasions. Book one small plan that's purely fun, not useful. Clear out a drawer. Mountains are meant to be stable, not frozen. A little change on the surface keeps the whole landscape alive and glowing.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Mu, your aura is a mountain. Calm, solid, everyone relaxes next to you.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: They also can't tell if you're happy or quietly filing a complaint.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Camel, rust, cream, a good wool coat. You look effortlessly expensive.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: And then the same grey hoodie four days in a row. I saw.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Your glow-up is sunlight on the peak. Same rock, golden.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Smile with your eyes, babe. People think you're mad at them.

spring.intro: Spring Wood breaks ground on Earth, which puts a spring Mu aura under steady pressure: a mountain with new growth on every slope. People read you as dependable and calm, the person everyone asks to mind their bag. Because the season leans on you, your style can become functional to the point of invisible: practical shoes, sensible neutrals, nothing that draws attention. Your glow-up is warmth and presence. Fire feeds Earth, so terracotta, rust and warm red give your steadiness heat. Keep your camel and stone base, then add one bold, warm statement piece each day, a bag, a knit, a coat. The spring Mu glow is the mountain at sunrise: same shape, suddenly golden.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Mu, you dress like the designated bag-holder. One terracotta coat and you're the destination.

summer.intro: Summer's Fire feeds Earth, so a summer Mu aura is a sun-baked mountain: solid, warm and very sure of itself. People read you as reliable and slightly unmovable, which works brilliantly in a meeting and less so on a fun night out. Your wardrobe is probably full of earthy tones that all look identical from across a room. Your glow-up is release. Metal, the element you produce, brings crisp white, silver and clean structure, and Water cools the heat with navy and deep blue. One sharp white shirt with a heavy silver piece makes your steadiness look modern rather than set in stone. Mountains look their best with clear sky around them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Mu, a white shirt and a chunky silver ring. Mountain, meet clear blue sky.

autumn.intro: In autumn your Earth pours itself into Metal, the element it produces, so an autumn Mu aura is a mountain rich with ore: generous and quietly valuable. People read you as wise and dependable, but sometimes as heavier or more serious than you actually are. Because you give so much energy away, your style can look tired: the same beige layers, the comfortable coat you have worn for five winters. Your glow-up is replenishment. Fire is your resource, so burnt orange, rust and warm cinnamon bring your warmth back to the surface. Pair them with a single gold accessory, treasure from your own mountain. People will say something changed. You just look like yourself, lit properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Mu, that coat has seen five winters. Cinnamon wool. Gold buttons. Retire the old one.

winter.intro: Winter is Water's season, and Earth is the element that holds Water back, so a winter Mu aura is a snowy mountain above a frozen lake: grand, quiet and a little hard to approach. People read you as composed and trustworthy, but they may hesitate before starting a conversation. Your wardrobe likely runs to dark, heavy, durable pieces chosen to last a decade. Your glow-up is heat. Fire is what a cold mountain needs, so bring in red, terracotta and warm ochre, and choose textures that look touchable: brushed wool, corduroy, soft suede. A warm-coloured scarf alone changes the first impression. The winter Mu glow is a lodge window on a mountain at night, and people walk toward it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Mu, ochre corduroy and a red scarf. You become the lodge everyone wants to reach.

strength.strong: A strong Mu Earth aura is a mountain that looks permanent. With plenty of Earth and Fire, you seem solid, reliable and unshakeable, and your style can be equally immovable: the same coat for years, the same palette of browns, the same bag in every photo since university. The blind spot is heaviness. People see dependable before they see interesting. Lighten up with Metal and Water: crisp white, silver, deep blue, a sharper cut. Try one unexpected piece every month and wear it with total confidence. The mountain stays exactly where it is. The view around it is allowed to change.
strength.weak: A weak Mu Earth aura is a hill that wants to be a mountain but keeps getting overlooked. With little Earth or Fire support, you may dress practically to the point of invisibility, choosing whatever is comfortable and inoffensive and cheap enough not to matter. The blind spot is shrinking: wearing clothes that quietly say 'don't mind me'. Your glow-up is substance. Choose one heavy, well-made piece in camel, terracotta or chocolate, a proper coat or a leather bag that will age well. Build around it. Let your presence feel substantial, because people trust what looks solid.

balance_text.too_much_wood: Too much Wood gives your aura lots of drive and upward energy, but it can read as restless or intense, always busy, always growing. Your style may lean practical and outdoorsy, sometimes at the expense of polish. Balance it with Metal touches: a crisp white shirt, silver jewellery, cleaner lines, one tailored piece. Declutter your wardrobe so what remains feels intentional. Your glow is strongest when your ambition looks calm, like a tall tree that doesn't need to prove it's growing.
balance_text.missing_wood: Missing Wood means your aura can lack a sense of freshness and new beginnings. You might stick to the same outfits for years or feel unsure about trying new styles. Bring in Wood: greens, botanical prints, natural fabrics like linen and cotton, plants in your space. Try one new style element each month, a different silhouette, a new accessory, a new hair clip. Growth looks good on you. Let your style evolve a little, the way spring changes a garden.
balance_text.too_much_fire: Too much Fire makes your aura bright, bold and sometimes overwhelming. You might gravitate to loud colours, big statements and high-energy looks that occasionally feel like too much at once. Balance it with Water: navy, deep blue, black accents, calmer silhouettes. Choose one statement per outfit instead of five. Let some quiet into your presence too, listening more, moving slower. Your glow is already strong. Cooling it slightly makes it look richer and more confident.
balance_text.missing_fire: Missing Fire means your aura can feel understated, sometimes so understated that people overlook you. You might default to neutrals and avoid anything that draws attention. Bring in Fire: a red lip, a coral scarf, warm gold jewellery, a little shimmer. Seek out sunlight in photos and in life. Let yourself be seen in small ways: post the photo, wear the bright thing, laugh openly. Visibility is a skill, and it looks lovely on you when you allow it.
balance_text.too_much_earth: Too much Earth gives you a grounded, warm aura that can slide into heavy or overly practical. Your wardrobe may be comfortable but samey, lots of beige, brown and safe basics. Balance it with Wood: fresh greens, lighter fabrics, a playful print, something that moves when you walk. Try one unexpected piece. Rearrange your space for a fresh feeling. Your stability is beautiful. A little lightness on top keeps it from looking stuck.
balance_text.missing_earth: Missing Earth can make your aura feel scattered or ungrounded, lots of ideas, many style moods, not much consistency. Your outfits may change wildly depending on your mood. Bring in Earth: camel, beige, warm brown, ochre, and solid basics like a good coat and reliable shoes. Build a small capsule wardrobe you can trust. Ceramics, wood and warm lighting at home help too. When your foundation is steady, your creativity looks intentional instead of chaotic.
balance_text.too_much_metal: Too much Metal gives your aura sharpness and polish that can tip into cold or severe. Your style may be immaculate but a little untouchable: very clean lines, lots of black, white and grey, everything controlled. Balance it with Fire: warm colours near your face, soft textures, a smile that comes sooner. Let one thing be imperfect on purpose, rolled sleeves, tousled hair, a playful accessory. Precision is your strength. Warmth makes it inviting.
balance_text.missing_metal: Missing Metal can make your aura feel soft but a little undefined. People like you, but they might not remember your style clearly. Bring in Metal: silver jewellery, crisp white, sharp tailoring, clean shoes, a structured bag. Edit your wardrobe so every piece earns its place. A clear signature, the same ring, the same scent, a consistent colour, gives your look definition. Clarity doesn't make you colder. It makes you memorable.
balance_text.too_much_water: Too much Water gives your aura depth and mystery, but it can read as distant, moody or hard to reach. You might hide in dark colours and oversized layers. Balance it with Earth: warm neutrals near your face, structured pieces, a grounded silhouette. Add a little Fire too, a coral or rose accent, to bring warmth. Let people see your expression clearly. Your mystery is magnetic. A bit of warmth makes it feel welcoming, not unreachable.
balance_text.missing_water: Missing Water means your aura can feel busy and bright without much depth or calm. You might always be on, always moving, with little stillness. Bring in Water: navy, midnight blue, black, flowing fabrics, a more relaxed silhouette. Create quiet moments in your day and let them show in your style, softer textures, fewer accessories. Water by your bed and slow evenings help your energy settle. Depth looks good on you. Give it some room.

too_much_wood.speaker: yeon
too_much_wood.text: Too much Wood: hiking boots, three plants and a tote bag. Add one sharp silver thing.

too_much_wood.speaker: bom
too_much_wood.text: Your freshness is gorgeous. A crisp white shirt makes it look intentional.

too_much_fire.speaker: yeon
too_much_fire.text: Too much Fire: red bag, gold chain, leopard coat. Pick one. The others can wait.

too_much_fire.speaker: bom
too_much_fire.text: Your warmth is your magic. Let navy or stone frame it.

too_much_earth.speaker: yeon
too_much_earth.text: Too much Earth: beige, oatmeal, sand, more beige. You look like a very calm cupboard.

too_much_earth.speaker: bom
too_much_earth.text: Your steadiness is beautiful. One silver piece or a deep blue lifts it.

too_much_metal.speaker: yeon
too_much_metal.text: Too much Metal: you look expensive and impossible to talk to. Add one soft texture.

too_much_metal.speaker: bom
too_much_metal.text: Your polish is stunning. A warm knit lets people come closer.

too_much_water.speaker: yeon
too_much_water.text: Too much Water: all black, all mystery, all the time. Even vampires wear burgundy.

too_much_water.speaker: bom
too_much_water.text: Your depth is magnetic. A warm colour helps people find the door.

missing_wood.speaker: bom
missing_wood.text: Missing Wood? Try a sage scarf or a leafy print. Let your style grow a little.

missing_wood.speaker: yeon
missing_wood.text: Same outfit since 2021 isn't a signature. It's a rut with good lighting.

missing_fire.speaker: bom
missing_fire.text: Missing Fire? A coral scarf or warm gold earrings changes how people greet you.

missing_fire.speaker: yeon
missing_fire.text: Head-to-toe grey says 'don't notice me'. Is that really the message?

missing_earth.speaker: bom
missing_earth.text: Missing Earth? A camel coat or a terracotta bag grounds your whole look.

missing_earth.speaker: yeon
missing_earth.text: Five trends this month, zero signature. Commit to something longer than a week.

missing_metal.speaker: bom
missing_metal.text: Missing Metal? A crisp white shirt or a silver cuff gives your look clean edges.

missing_metal.speaker: yeon
missing_metal.text: Everything slightly creased and slightly oversized reads accidental. Tailor one piece.

missing_water.speaker: bom
missing_water.text: Missing Water? Deep navy or a fluid silk adds calm depth to your look.

missing_water.speaker: yeon
missing_water.text: Always bright, always on. Let one outfit be quiet. People lean in.
